walkthroughs.body_html:
Photography and Lens-based Media — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Photography and Lens-based Media brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Photography and Lens-based Media.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What attitude does Pop Art take toward consumer culture?
options: Ambiguous - it both celebrates and critiques mass media imagery.
It straightforwardly celebrates capitalism.
It rejects all modern imagery.
Using exactly three colours.

mcqs.q: What is the rule of thirds?
options: A strict mathematical rule that must never be broken.
He painted indoor scenes.
A guideline placing key elements along lines or intersections of a 3x3 grid.
Using exactly three colours.

mcqs.q: What did Pollock mean by his drip paintings being 'in the painting'?
options: He worked from all sides, making the act of painting central to the meaning.
It rejects all modern imagery.
He painted indoor scenes.
He literally fell into wet paint.
